shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -c "pwd && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g 'next.config.*' -g 'app/**' -g 'src/**' -g 'pages/**' -g 'node_modules/next/dist/docs/**' | head -200 && git status --short"

/bin/bash -c "cat AGENTS.md && printf '\\n--- package ---\\n' && cat package.json && printf '\\n--- next config ---\\n' && cat next.config.ts && printf '\\n--- user package diff ---\\n' && git diff -- package.json"

/bin/bash -c "find app -maxdepth 5 -type f -print && printf '\\n--- app routes ---\\n' && for f in app/page.tsx app/layout.tsx 'app/products/[slug]/page.tsx'; do echo \"--- "'$f"; sed -n '"'1,260p' \""'$f"; done && printf '"'\\n--- docs candidates ---\\n' && rg --files node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head -100"
/bin/bash -c "rg --files node_modules/next/dist/docs | rg -i 'cache|stream|suspense|searchparams|connection|dynamic'"

/bin/bash -c "rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' && printf '\\n--- source tree ---\\n' && find . -maxdepth 3 -type d -not -path './node_modules*' -not -path './.git*' -print | sort && printf '\\n--- refs to product/cache/dynamic ---\\n' && rg -n \"getProduct|getRelatedProducts|use cache|unstable_cache|force-dynamic|dynamic|Suspense|currency\" --glob '"'!node_modules/**'"' ."

/bin/bash -c "sed -n '1,260p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/migrating-to-cache-components.md && printf '\\n--- config ---\\n' && sed -n '1,240p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/05-config/01-next-config-js/cacheComponents.md && printf '\\n--- use cache ---\\n' && sed -n '1,300p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/01-directives/use-cache.md"

/bin/bash -c "printf '%s\\n' '--- streaming ---' && sed -n '1,280p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/streaming.md && printf '\\n--- connection ---\\n' && sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/connection.md && printf '\\n--- cacheLife ---\\n' && sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/cacheLife.md && printf '\\n--- products ---\\n' && cat lib/products.ts && printf '\\n--- tsconfig ---\\n' && cat tsconfig.json"

/bin/bash -c 'rg -n "generateStaticParams|searchParams|Suspense|dynamic params|runtime data|cacheComponents|use cache|uncached data|static shell|instant" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/migrating-to-cache-components.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/01-directives/use-cache.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/05-config/01-next-config-js/cacheComponents.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/connection.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/streaming.md'

/bin/bash -c "sed -n '1,200p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/05-config/01-next-config-js/cacheComponents.md && printf '\\n--- cache directive start/constraints ---\\n' && sed -n '1,230p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/01-directives/use-cache.md && printf '\\n--- dynamic route docs files ---\\n' && rg --files node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app | rg 'generate-static-params|dynamic-routes|searchParams|page\\.md'"

/bin/bash -c "rg -n \"generatestaticparams-and-dynamicparams|generateStaticParams|searchParams|params\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/migrating-to-cache-components.md | head -70 && printf '\\n--- migration route params section ---\\n' && sed -n '500,710p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/migrating-to-cache-components.md && printf '\\n--- generateStaticParams guide ---\\n' && sed -n '1,260p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/generate-static-params.md && printf '\\n--- page API searchParams ---\\n' && rg -n -C 5 \"searchParams|Suspense|params\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/page.md | head -140"

/bin/bash -c "sed -n '574,735p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/migrating-to-cache-components.md && printf '\\n--- use cache key/args ---\\n' && rg -n -C 4 \"arguments|cache key|reusable|shared|requests|function\" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/01-directives/use-cache.md | head -170 && printf '\\n--- next version ---\\n' && node -p \"require('./node_modules/next/package.json').version\""

/bin/bash -c 'git diff -- tsconfig.json && git diff -- package.json && git status --short --untracked-files=all'

/bin/bash -c "git status --short && printf '\\n--- tracked diff ---\\n' && git diff -- next.config.ts lib/products.ts 'app/products/[slug]/page.tsx' tsconfig.json && printf '\\n--- product route metadata ---\\n' && rg -n \"use cache|cacheLife|generateStaticParams|Suspense|currency|related\" next.config.ts lib/products.ts 'app/products/[slug]/page.tsx'"
/bin/bash -c 'npm run start -- --hostname 127.0.0.1'

/bin/bash -c "set -e
for spec in 'lamp EUR EUR 110.40' 'lamp USD USD 120.00' 'vase EUR EUR 73.60'; do
  read -r slug query expected amount <<<\""'$spec"
  body=$(curl -fsS "http://127.0.0.1:3000/products/$slug?currency=$query")
  printf '"'%s: ' \"/products/"'$slug?currency=$query"
  printf '"'%s' \""'$body" | rg -o "${expected} ${amount}" | head -1
  printf '"'%s' \""'$body" | rg -q '"'Loading related products'
done
body="'$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '"'%{http_code}' 'http://127.0.0.1:3000/products/missing')
printf 'unknown slug status: %s\\n' \""'$body"
'

/bin/bash -c "git diff -- next-env.d.ts && printf '\\n--- current tsconfig ---\\n' && cat tsconfig.json && printf '\\n--- generated build directory ---\\n' && test -d .next && printf '.next exists (generated by build)\\n'"
/bin/bash -c 'git clean -fd -- .next && git status --short'
/bin/bash -c 'git diff -- next-env.d.ts tsconfig.json && git status --short'
/bin/bash -c 'git diff --check && git status --short'
